sentences.text: John Constantine -LRB- -LSB- ˈkɒnstəntaɪn -RSB- -RRB- is a fictional antihero , appearing in comic books published by DC Comics and the DC Comics imprint Vertigo .	DC Comics	DC Comics	Vertigo	Vertigo (DC Comics)	antihero	antihero	Constantine	Constantine (TV series)
The character first appeared in Swamp Thing Vol .	Swamp Thing	Swamp Thing
2 No. 25 -LRB- June 1984 -RRB- , and was created by Alan Moore , Steve Bissette and John Totleben .	Alan Moore	Alan Moore	Steve Bissette	Steve Bissette	John Totleben	John Totleben

He serves as the lead character of the comic books Hellblazer -LRB- 1988 -- 2013 -RRB- , Constantine -LRB- 2013 -- 15 -RRB- , Constantine : The Hellblazer -LRB- 2015 -- 16 -RRB- , and The Hellblazer -LRB- 2016 -- -RRB- .	lead character	protagonist	Hellblazer	Hellblazer	Constantine	Constantine (TV series)

The titular Hellblazer , Constantine is a working class occult detective and con man stationed in London .	Hellblazer	Hellblazer	Constantine	Constantine (TV series)	working class	working class	occult detective	occult detective	con man	Confidence trick

He is known for his endless cynicism , deadpan snarking , ruthless cunning and constant chain smoking , but is also a passionate humanist driven by a heartfelt desire to do some good in his life .	cynicism	Cynicism (contemporary)	deadpan	deadpan	humanist	Humanism

Originally a supporting character who played a pivotal role in the `` American Gothic '' Swamp Thing storyline , Constantine received his own comic in 1988 .	Swamp Thing	Swamp Thing	Constantine	Constantine (TV series)
Pop artist Sting served as visual inspiration for the character .	Sting	Sting (musician)

A live-action film was released in 2005 entitled Constantine , in which an Americanized version of the character is played by actor Keanu Reeves .	Constantine	Constantine (TV series)	Keanu Reeves	Keanu Reeves

Welsh actor Matt Ryan was cast in the role of Constantine for the 2014 NBC television series Constantine , a role he reprised on The CW series Arrow , the animated film Justice League Dark and is set to reprise again in an upcoming animated continuation of his series on CW Seed .
